turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I use bleach on my wooden cutting board?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Bleach can dry out and crack wood, so I'd avoid it. Hot soapy water and drying it standing up is usually enough.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What if I cut raw chicken on it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then scrub it well and wipe it with plain white vinegar. Even better, keep a plastic board just for raw meat.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: kind of like onions all the time.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Rub it with half a lemon and some coarse salt, then rinse. That takes out most smells.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, once a month with food safe mineral oil. It keeps the wood from drying out and cracking.
